newsitem.title: USA: Estee Lauder says meets seasonal goal. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Estee Lauder says meets seasonal goal. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]

text.p: Estee Lauder Cos Inc said on Tuesday it met its top-line growth goals and exceeded the U.S. cosmetic department store growth during the Christmas period.

Speaking at Goldman Sachs' sixth annual consumer products conference in Florida, Fred Langhammer, president and chief operating officer, said "From a global perspective, our broad geographic base and diverse brand portfolio has enabled us to meet our top line growth objectives for the season."
The cosmetics company said it could not provide specific figures because it is in the quiet period before it releases its second-quarter (corrects from year-end) earnings at the end of the month.
